description: Tennis Warehouse — racquet catalog, used inventory, and the cross-entity queries the website can't answer.

tools.name: racquets_catalog
tools.description: Fetch the all-racquets landing page (featured + best-sellers across every brand).

tools.name: used_get
tools.description: Fetch the detail page for a used model (full spec sheet + individual unit listings). Required: pcode.

params.name: pcode
params.description: Model SKU (e.g., WB9810, PS9818). Find these via `used list` or the website's used catalog pages.

tools.name: used_list
tools.description: List used-racquet models stocked for a brand. Required: ccode (default: WILSONRACS).

params.name: ccode
params.description: Brand code (e.g., WILSONRACS, BABRACS, HEADRACS, YONEXRACS, BABBABRACS). Visit /usedracquets.html to see the full list.
